decisions.statement: The glyph row and the legend are two drawings of one set of stoplights.
The glyph row takes each stoplight's tier and the legend takes each label.
A legend parts one label from the next with a spaced middle dot.
Each tier has one glyph named here.
Nothing here names which readouts a group holds.
Nothing here names the label a readout carries.
Nothing here names the scale a reading is read against.

definition: the glyph row and the legend a set of stoplights is drawn as
